name: Ngwane III
title: King
description: Founder of the Swazi nation; led the Dlamini people to Swaziland

name: Sobhuza I
title: King
description: Second king; consolidated Swazi territory and repelled Zulu incursions

name: Mswati I
title: King
description: Third king; expanded Swazi territory to its greatest extent

name: Mbandzeni
title: King
description: Fifth king; granted many concessions to Europeans during the concession rush

name: Bhunu
title: King
description: Sixth king; tried by colonial court in 1898 following the Mbhulazwe incident

name: Labotsibeni
title: Queen Regent
description: Queen regent who fought colonial partition; mother of Bhunu

name: Mahlanya
title: Warrior
description: The protagonist; reckless one; warrior of the colonial resistance era
